name: Red Hat
summary:
Red Hat provides enterprise open source platforms for hybrid cloud, automation, and Kubernetes environments.

Together, we help organisations design, integrate, and operate Red Hat technologies across secure, production-ready infrastructure platforms.
overview:
Red Hat technologies sit at the core of many modern enterprise platforms.

Together, we help organisations build, integrate, and operate Red Hat environments across cloud, hybrid, and on-premises infrastructure. From Red Hat Enterprise Linux and automation through to OpenShift and Kubernetes platforms, we help teams create environments that are reliable, secure, and operationally consistent.

Our focus is on building strong platform foundations that support long-term operations. This includes automation, observability, lifecycle management, platform security, and delivery enablement across complex infrastructure environments.

We help organisations reduce operational complexity, improve resilience, and deliver platforms with confidence.
